# Fontora

> Fontora is a free, open-source font library offering 807+ high-quality fonts across 40+ languages and writing systems. Every font is 100% free for both personal and commercial use under the SIL Open Font License or Apache License 2.0. No sign-up required, no paywalls.

**Website:** https://www.fontora.fun
**Founder:** Mukeshkumar Parmar
**Location:** Vadodara, Gujarat, India
**Contact:** yourtimesstart@gmail.com
**Total fonts:** 807+
**Languages supported:** 40+ (Indian, East Asian, Southeast Asian, Middle Eastern, European)

## Key Facts

- All 807+ fonts are free for personal AND commercial use
- Licensed under SIL OFL 1.1 or Apache 2.0 — no royalties, no attribution required
- Fonts can be downloaded in TTF or WOFF2 format directly from the browser
- The website auto-detects visitor's country via geolocation and translates the UI into 16 languages (English, Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Arabic, Chinese Simplified, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Russian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Bengali)
- Supports 9 Indian languages with native-script preview text: Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Punjabi, Odia
- Wedding/calligraphy category contains 114 elegant script fonts including Great Vibes, Dancing Script, Allura, Parisienne, Cormorant, Style Script, and Pacifico
- Perfect for Etsy sellers, Canva designers, book publishers, wedding planners, academic research, and commercial branding
- Built with pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks, no tracking, no advertising cookies (only Google AdSense)
- Google AdSense publisher: ca-pub-3599607968266007

## Website Features

1. **Live font preview** — type any text, adjust size (14-120px), color, and background color in real time
2. **Category filtering** — 41 categories including a dedicated Indian Languages dropdown and World Languages filter
3. **Instant search** — client-side search across all 807 fonts in milliseconds
4. **One-click download** — TTF and WOFF2 files saved directly to the user's device
5. **Geolocation auto-language** — detects visitor's country and translates the UI (16 languages)
6. **Manual language switcher** — searchable dropdown with native-language labels
7. **Character map** — modal showing each font's Latin character set
8. **Floating share button** — share to WhatsApp, Facebook, X, Telegram, LinkedIn, Email, or copy link
9. **Responsive design** — works on mobile, tablet, and desktop
10. **No account required** — every feature available without sign-up

## Licensing

All fonts on Fontora are distributed under one of two open-source licenses:

- **SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL):** Free to use, modify, and redistribute. Fonts cannot be sold on their own. No attribution required for typical use.
- **Apache License 2.0:** Permissive free software license allowing commercial use, modification, and distribution.

Fonts are sourced from the Google Fonts open-source repository and the Noto fonts project by Google. Fontora does not host or distribute any proprietary or pirated fonts.

## Commercial Use Cases

Every font can be used for:

- **Etsy shops** — logos, product images, listing photos, digital downloads, packaging
- **Canva designs** — social media graphics, presentations, posters, marketing materials
- **Book publishing** — book covers, interior text, eBooks, print-on-demand (KDP, IngramSpark, Lulu)
- **Wedding planning** — invitations, save-the-dates, programs, menus, signage, thank-you cards
- **Academic research** — papers, posters, presentations, dissertations, conference materials
- **Logos and branding** — company logos, brand identity, business cards, letterheads
- **Websites and apps** — web fonts (WOFF2), UI design, landing pages
- **Merchandise** — t-shirts, mugs, stickers, prints
- **Advertising** — digital ads, billboards, brochures, flyers
- **YouTube and video** — thumbnails, titles, lower thirds, credits

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks)
- **Font loading:** Font Loading API (FontFace) with lazy loading via IntersectionObserver
- **CJK fonts:** Loaded from Google Fonts CDN to reduce bundle size
- **Internationalization:** Custom i18n system with 16 UI languages
- **Geolocation:** ipapi.co, ipapi.com, api.country.is with 4-second timeout and browser-language fallback
- **SEO:** JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, FAQPage, WebApplication, BreadcrumbList, Person, ContactPage, PrivacyPolicy), XML sitemaps, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, robots.txt
- **AI / GEO:** llms.txt and llms-full.txt, explicit AI crawler allow directives in robots.txt, AEO/GEO meta tags
- **Monetization:** Google AdSense Auto Ads
- **Hosting:** Static files at https://www.fontora.fun
